tool_input.prompt:
Restyle this ONE fictional Guarin character as a new rendering of the EXACT SAME costume, pose, silhouette, proportions, equipment, color placement, lighting direction and camera. Keep the huge upright full-face flat-crowned cylindrical iron greathelm, two faceplate rivet strips, the black visor and round breathing holes, wine-red neck scarf/cape and ragged waist cloth, ring-mail shirt/sleeves, brown belt with rectangular buckle, brown gloves, forearm/leg wraps and rounded short boots. Keep his right-hand sword at image LEFT crossing toward the lower RIGHT, straight blade and crossguard, disk pommel, and the same wooden kite shield at image RIGHT with iron rim and the same narrow wine-red panel. Preserve the current deep crown ellipse and every body/weapon contour; do not rotate or tilt the head, change plate seams, add cross bars, lengthen limbs, change the shield outline, or alter the stance. The head stays huge and the body tiny. Hold the dark charcoal background and muted wine/taupe/iron palette. This is the established design of a returning Royans/Isere household knight in the 1101 story, with its explicitly allowed full-face greathelm anachronism: add no foreign heraldry, royal ornament, scale armor or plate body armor. Keep every costume structure but rebuild how it is drawn and shaded. No captions, text, extra characters or panels.

Render it as almost outline-free matte dry GOUACHE with fine deliberate pixel clusters. Replace the smooth black contours and flat cel fills with broad opaque pigment patches, soft but decisive colored shadow transitions, tiny stepped colored edge clusters and sparse dry-brush scumbling. Build form from color boundaries, not black cartoon ink; express ring mail with restrained small painted loop signs. Keep velvety dull iron, opaque worn cloth and restrained mineral highlights. It should visibly resemble a handmade miniature gouache game illustration, never glossy realistic 3D, huge coarse pixel blocks or a blur filter.
